Services / Managed Digital Support
04 · support

One person, on call for everything digital

Most agencies disappear after launch. We assign you a dedicated person who already knows your project, and stays reachable for the ongoing small stuff — so you're never stuck finding someone new for digital work.

Start a project →
the problem

Once a project ships, most agencies move on to the next client. Small requests — a copy change, a broken form, a new landing page for a campaign — end up either ignored, routed through a generic support ticket, or handed to someone who has to re-learn your project from zero every time.

our approach

You get one assigned person (backed by the full team when something needs deeper expertise) who already has context on your build. Small requests get handled directly. Anything that grows into real project scope gets flagged clearly before any additional cost, so there's never a surprise invoice for what felt like a quick ask.

what's included
01

A dedicated point of contact

One assigned person who knows your project — not a rotating support queue.

02

04

05

06

Direct access, no ticket queue

Reach your assigned person directly — email, chat, or call, whichever fits how you work.
